failure_condition: Keyboard focus has no visible indicator in the controlled button fixture.
preconditions: Load either TC13 variant and focus the target using keyboard.
interaction_steps: Capture computed focus styles and screenshot.
expected_outcome: The control renders a visible focus indicator.
manual_verification_method: Inspect the rendered focused control at the agreed viewport and contrast conditions.
dom_testability: Computed style is a proxy; visual replacement indicators require rendering inspection.
accessibility_tree_testability: Accessibility Tree does not encode visual focus-indicator visibility.
limitations: Presence of outline is not equivalent to visibility; color, clipping, occlusion, and other indicators matter.
